findings.issue: Still open from the last review: the heading 'Related products and services' sits over a single link to Terms and Conditions, which is neither a product nor a service, so the heading promises what the section doesn't give.
findings.reference: The competitor's onward links say where they lead (e.g. 'Read the full group story … at PT King Trading').
findings.fix: Site Factory: retitle the section to match its link (e.g. 'Related policies'), or link the product and service pages the heading names.

findings.issue: Still open from the last review: on phones the tinted related band has about 38px above its heading and below its button, roughly half the intro section's top gap (~73px), so the heading sits close to the band's top edge and the band looks cramped.
findings.reference: The competitor keeps one even vertical gap between its content sections.
findings.fix: In reference.css, give the relatedPages section (`.block--related-pages` or the template's equivalent) the template's normal section block padding instead of the reduced one, so it matches the overview section.

findings.issue: The closing photo panel has about 44px of white above it but about 88px of white under it before the footer (34px / 73px on phones), so the page ends on an empty white strip between the photo and the navy footer.
findings.reference: The competitor's last content section runs straight into its footer with no extra white band.
findings.fix: In reference.css, make the cta block's bottom padding equal its top padding (or remove the extra margin above `.site-footer`), so the space above and below the photo panel is the same.
